integrity: The correction is derived directly from a self-contained game-tree proof and compared against the two primary source statements; no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The correction is restricted to complete multipartite graphs with at least two parts and every part of size at least two.
The two published parity propositions are retained; only the subsequent claimed equivalence is corrected.
Finite minimax verification through order ten corroborates but does not replace the all-orders proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed prior correction.
title: A parity correction for general-position games on complete multipartite graphs
